picks.title: Clear dark sky tomorrow 3am
picks.body: 92% clear for about 3 h from 3am, moon 6% lit. Try Prineville Reservoir State Park (International Dark Sky Park) (~200 km away).
why: 3 forecast hours with ≥60% clear sky in darkness (HRRR)

picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 6:54am
picks.body: 69% odds of colour. Best bets: Milo McIver Memorial Viewpoint, Scout pick: Sunrise behind Mt. Hood from the McIver viewpoint, Columbia Hills: Dalles Mountain Ranch. Horizon toward the sun is 83% open.
why: 69% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 83% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon

picks.title: Sea of fog Sun Nov 8 6:56am
picks.body: 100% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.
why: 100% chance of fog or low cloud in the valley at sunrise (HRRR)
picks.lens: 70-300 to stack the ridges above the fog; 16-50 for the wide view
